what_happened.line: The committee decided to put new studio options on the agenda for its next meeting, after the capital request for a new studio was reduced.
The committee heard that a new space is unlikely in the next fiscal year, so its potential capital request for a studio was cut back.
The TC Passios building reuse committee is still refining its cost estimate for reuse versus demolition and rebuild.
The manager reported on March activity, football broadcasts, staffing and finances, including a new monitor for hybrid meetings and pricing for interview equipment kits.
The March minutes were taken up and a vote was held, but the outcome is not audible in the recording. The next meeting was set for May 3.

why_it_matters: The committee's studio plans depend on whether the TC Passios building is reused, and that choice is not yet settled, so public access cable gets no new space in the near term.
The committee is funded through cable fees and the town's indirect-cost arrangement, so the shelved capital request means no new studio spending is planned for next year's budget.
